dumbbell-deadlift.criteria: Two dumbbells outside legs in suitcase style. Knees and hips extend together. Neutral grips and fixed feet; return weights to floor.

single-arm-dumbbell-deadlift.criteria: One dumbbell at side, knees bend with hip hinge; hand descends to mid shin, extend hips and knees. No side bending or rotation. Free hand empty.

partial-deadlift.criteria: High rack pull variation: bar supported at knee height, extend hips to standing, return onto pins. Partial deadlift is a range category; this video depicts the high rack variant.

limits: Procedural demonstration, eight-second cycle. Sampled joints and geometry are not exhaustive mesh collision or biomechanical certification. Physical-device and production verification pending.
